description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'BaseMapper' providing conversion methods between entity objects and data transfer objects (DTOs). It includes methods for converting single objects, collections, lists, and sets, utilizing Java Streams for collection transformations.

classes.name: BaseMapper
classes.description: Abstract generic class for converting between entity and DTO objects using Java Generics and Streams.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a DTO to an entity object, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Converts an entity object to a DTO, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to entities using stream mapping.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to DTOs using stream mapping.

methods.name: convertToEntityList
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a List of entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoList
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to a List of DTOs.

methods.name: convertToEntitySet
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a Set of entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoSet
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to a Set of DTOs.
